name: Static logo row
for: A row of brands the product works with or its real customers.
how: Show the existing list of marks and names in place.
rules: Real brands only, and only ones the product really works with or real customers who agreed.
Marks in one muted colour, never their brand colours here.
a11y: A labelled list of names in text; the marks are aria-hidden and the list holds only <li>.
